description: Machine-readable catalog of CrossPad compile-time config. Mirrors Configuration.h / Configuration_adv.h; the headers stay the documented, hand-editable source of defaults, this file is what the app manager TUI renders and what generates -D overrides.

groups.title: Pads
groups.help: Pad data model depth and pad editors.

flags.name: CROSSPAD_BOARD
flags.help: Selects the per-revision board profile (board_v1.h / board_v2.h / board_pc.h) that supplies tuned default values.

flags.name: CROSSPAD_PAD_CONFIG_LEVEL

values.label: GLOBAL — one value for all pads

flags.help: Pad tuning depth. GLOBAL collapses the 16-element arrays to a single value: less RAM, fewer NVS keys, and the per-pad editors compile out.

flags.name: FEAT_PAD_EDITOR
flags.help: Interactive per-pad STM analog tuning screen (Settings -> Analog/Velocity -> Per-Pad Tuning).

flags.name: FEAT_SETTINGS_BACKUP
flags.help: Settings -> Backup (SD): export/import settings and pad tuning as JSON. Drop on units without a card slot.

flags.name: FEAT_PERF_STATS
flags.help: Settings -> System -> Perf Stats: FPS / CPU / memory overlays in the status bar.
